string.name: what_s_new_latest
string.font:
In-App Language Selection: Easily switch your preferred app language directly from the settings screen. 
 New Language Support: Added full translations for French, Italian, Russian, and Galician. 
 Media Viewer Enhancements: Enjoy a smoother media viewing experience with polished crossfade backgrounds and improved display controls. 
 Custom ROM Compatibility: Improved app detection and stability on custom ROMs and FOSS setups by preventing false store availability alerts. 
 Reliable Background Lock: Fixed an issue where the app would unexpectedly lock when returning after activity recreation.
